 Print KPSC hall ticket 2026 : The Karnataka Public Service Commission (KPSC) has released the hall ticket for the Kannada Viva Voce Test under the Departmental Examinations (DE-2026 I-Session). Candidates who have successfully applied for the examination can download their hall tickets from the commission’s official website, kpsc.karnataka.gov.in, using their registration number and other required login credentials. The Kannada viva voce test is scheduled to be conducted from October 28 to October 31, 2026. Candidates are advised to download their hall tickets before the examination and check the details mentioned on the document. KPSC hall ticket 2026: Steps to download admit card
 Candidates can follow the steps elucidated here to download the KPSC hall tickets 2026 on the official website: Visit the official KPSC website at kpsc.karnataka.gov.in.
 Look for the link related to the Departmental Examinations DE-2026 I-Session Kannada Viva Voce Test hall ticket.
 Click on the hall ticket download link.
 Enter the required login details, including the registration number, and provide any other information requested on the portal.
 Submit the details to access the hall ticket.
 Download the hall ticket PDF and take a printout for future reference.
 Candidates should ensure that the details entered on the login page match the information provided during the application process. Alternatively, candidates can click on the link provided here to download the KPSC hall ticket 2026. KPSC hall ticket 2026: What to do if the download fails?
 Candidates may encounter technical difficulties while downloading their hall tickets. Incorrect login credentials, a slow internet connection or temporary website issues may prevent access to the document. Candidates should recheck their registration details and ensure that the information entered is correct. If the website is unresponsive, they can try again after some time or use a stable internet connection. Clearing the browser cache or switching to another browser may also help resolve certain technical issues. If the problem persists, candidates should seek assistance through the official KPSC website rather than relying on unofficial download links. Candidates appearing for the Kannada Viva Voce Test should download their hall tickets well before the examination dates to avoid last-minute technical difficulties.
